boundary: sub-object bounds inside ONE allocation (av_refstruct / av_malloc)
title: Upstream FFmpeg spatial defects that cross a bound BETWEEN TWO MEMBERS of one allocation
note: A sibling of pool-repros, deliberately separate: that corpus's boundary is storage an AVBufferPool handed out, and these defects cross a bound inside a single allocation, which is a different boundary. The seam is a verbatim copy of pool-repros' -- each corpus owns a private copy, and the FF2_* infrastructure macros come from the port's replay-config. All three cases are LIVE at the n9.0.1 pin. No arm we have catches any of them; the oracle is the upstream fix, and the ASan arm is measured blind with a positive control. Triage: docs/ref/ffmpeg-spatial-defect-triage.md.
